title: Khadija bint Khuwaylid
note: Prominent pre-Islamic Meccan merchant and first wife of Muhammad; first convert to Islam and critical early financial and moral patron during the formative Meccan persecution.

title: First Muslim migration to the Kingdom of Aksum (Abyssinia)
note: Early flight of persecuted Meccan Muslims to the Christian Negus (Najashi) of the Kingdom of Aksum, marking the first interfaith refuge and earliest expansion of the Islamic community into Sub-Saharan Africa.

title: Bilal ibn Rabah
note: Formerly enslaved Abyssinian companion of Muhammad who became the first muezzin (caller to prayer) in Islam, representing the prominent role of African and formerly enslaved individuals in the foundational Medina community.

title: Promulgation of the Constitution of Medina (Sahifat al-Madina)
note: Foundational constitutional compact establishing the civil umma, mutual defense obligations, and religious protection between Muslim Emigrants, local Medina tribes, and Jewish clans.
